modules.module_title: Maintain safe and secure working environment

pcs.pc_description: organize work as per the organization’s health, safety and security policies and procedures
identify the risks and hazards associated while driving and their causes and preventions
check and ensure the functioning of vehicle before commencing work
identify and report vehicle maintenance and repair requirements/risks as per SOP, if any
take corrective measures and follow standard first-aid procedures in case of an accident
ensure safety of all passengers and immediately report any breaches to the appropriate authority
ensure vehicle and equipment are regularly cleaned and sanitized
wash hands with soap and use alcohol-based sanitizer regularly
avoid contact with ill people and self-isolate in a similar situation
wear and dispose of PPEs regularly and appropriately
report hygiene and sanitation issues to appropriate authority, if any
follow processes specified for disposal of hazardous waste
identify ways to optimize usage of fuel (Petrol/diesel/CNG) in the vehicle
use resources in a responsible manner
check for spills/leakages in the vehicle with caution
plug spills/leakages of fuel (Petrol/diesel/CNG), oil/coolant or water from the vehicle and escalate to appropriate authority if unable to rectify
report malfunctioning (fumes/sparks/emission/vibration/noise) and lapse in maintenance of the vehicle
ensure the various equipment of the vehicle is properly connected

modules.module_title: Examine the vehicle before the trip

pcs.pc_description: inspect and conform the vehicle’s condition as per health and safety guidelines before starting the trip
ensure the vehicle meets the legal and compliance requirements like pollution test, load limit, etc.
perform routine maintenance checks on the vehicle for tyre pressure, fuel (Petrol/diesel/CNG) level, working of headlights and brakes, CNG cylinder valves etc.
check vehicle service record for any history of technical defects or immediate need for servicing like oil/filter change, etc.
prepare a to-do list for repair requirement, if any
record all deviations observed while carrying out checks
report actual or potential defects/deviations to the senior driver/owner/service supervisor
determine roadworthiness of the vehicle and use another vehicle if the current vehicle is found unfit
confirm all gauges and warning lights are functioning properly before moving the vehicle

modules.module_title: Drive the LMV conforming to the standard driving practices

pcs.pc_description: perform pre-driving activities like shoulder checking, adjusting IRVM/ ORVM and releasing of handbrakes, etc.
insert or press the ignition key/button to start the vehicle
coordinate gear changes, if any, with appropriate use of clutch/acceleration and steering control
maneuver the vehicle safely and responsibly while regulating the speed in all weather and road conditions by coordinating the operation of all controls
use the accelerator, steering control and brakes correctly for safe driving, stopping and parking the vehicle
ensure maximum fuel (Petrol/diesel/CNG) efficiency while driving
follow guidelines on the road while driving like avoiding excessive honking, driving on high beam, loud music, etc.
maintain a safe distance from other vehicles
ensure the vehicle is within the prescribed speed limits at all times and avoid rod hog
ensure proper parking at appropriate spots
adhere to local and state specific driving laws and traffic regulations, including overloading
turn off ignition at red lights or after parking the vehicle to enhance fuel efficiency
monitor and respond correctly to gauges, warning lights, CNG leakage etc. while driving
ensure to stop the vehicle at a safe place in case of any malfunction and turn off the ignition
carry out a quick diagnostic check
carry out minor adjustments or temporary repairs like replacement/top-up of oil, change of tyres/wipers, etc. if possible
report the exact nature of the problem to the supervisor to get appropriate help from the command office
take the vehicle to the service point for corrective action in case of major defect or accident

pcs.pc_description: report to the authorised person on time as per the duty schedule
wear proper uniform on duty and follow orgnizational safety policy for himself and passenger like PPE kit, hand gloves, sanitiser spray, etc. as per standards

modules.module_title: Liaise with the control room/depot/branch office/authorized person

pcs.pc_description: obtain daily duty schedule from the reporting manager at the depo/branch office
coordinate with control room regarding passenger details, pickup location, route and information about the traffic
inform the reporting manager well in advance in case of sickness, leave or delay in reaching/picking up the passenger at their destination

modules.module_title: Escalate the problem to supervisor/authorized person

pcs.pc_description: report any vehicle defects or maintenance requirements to the authorised person as per SOP
inform the authorized person about incidents like accidents, breakdowns, change in route/destination, unpaid trips, etc. happened during performing the duty if any

modules.module_title: Drop the passenger safely at the destination

pcs.pc_description: check and confirm the details of the passenger and destination before the pick-up
reach the pick-up location on time and greet the passenger as per standards
provide assistance to the passenger while entering and exiting the vehicle, if required
assist passenger in loading their luggage and arranging them in the boot or at the appropriate place in the vehicle
secure the overhead luggage with waterproof/resistant sheets/cover in case of rainfall
operate infotainment system or entertainment media available inside the vehicle as per the contract or passenger convenience
use advanced driving and safety features of vehicle like Cruise Control, ADAS etc. as per the requirement
perform trip-end activities at the control room post dropping of the passenger like taking payments, providing receipt etc.

follow proper duty closure procedure on completion of tasks for the day like cleaning of vehicle, parking at the designated area, securing the vehicle, visual checks and handing over the vehicle keys to the manager
maintain a monthly vehicle log book to record the number of trips, daily run in km, repairs and fuel filled
